title: Salmon poke bowl with edamame and avocado
steps: Wash the rice and cook it covered with 160 ml water for 12 minutes, mix with the rice vinegar and let it cool.
Dice very fresh (sushi-grade) salmon and marinate it with the soy sauce and sesame oil for 10 minutes.
Boil the edamame for 4 minutes, slice the cucumber and avocado and cut the carrot into fine strips.
Put the rice in bowls, arrange the salmon and vegetables on top and sprinkle with sesame and spring onion.
